name: MediaPlayerShell
summary: Layout shell hosting a media player and its chrome.

a11y.apg: No role and no keyboard: it draws the player surface and nothing else. Every semantic — the control group, the labelled buttons, the native range inputs — belongs to MediaPlayer.

props.name: children
props.description: The chrome you compose, hosted by the frame. What the frame gives you is worth naming, because rebuilding it by hand is where players go wrong: the dark canvas that stays dark in both themes, overflow clipping so nothing escapes the rounded corner, an isolated stacking context so .media-overlay-title and .media-controls layer above the picture without z-index fights, and a fixed aspect-ratio so the page does not jump before the media has measured itself. Slots it is built for: .media-viewport (picture or placeholder), .media-overlay-title, .media-controls. Use it when the default chrome would be WRONG — a live stream has no duration and nothing to seek, so a seek bar there is a control that lies. For a player that plays, use MediaPlayer.

props.name: className
props.description: On the surface. Every other div attribute passes through.
